tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (479)༄༅/ /dpal bde mchog snyan brgyud las/bum dbang dang 'brel ba'i nyams len thun mong yid bzhin nor bu'i khrid yig rje mi las mdzad pa bzhugs so/
(479)༄༅/ /dpal bde mchog snyan brgyud las/bum dbang dang 'brel ba'i nyams len thun mong yid bzhin nor bu'i khrid yig rje mi las mdzad pa bzhugs so/

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (479)༄༅// dpal bde mchog snyan brgyud las/ bum dbang dang 'brel ba'i nyams len thun mong yid bzhin nor bu'i khrid yig rje mi las mdzad pa bzhugs so//

(480)༄༅// na mo gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi mchod 'os yon tan gter// yid bzhin nor bu gdung ba kun sel 'gran zla bral// dri med nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sems can kun kyi dpal// bde chen bde mchog bla ma gsum la gus pas 'dud// ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i gsang tshig /'gro rnams dag pa'i gnas su 'dren par byed pa// bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang gis rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la gdams pa/ ji srid sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba de srid du 'gro don cher 'byung ba'i don du/ brgyud pa bcu gsum gyi bar du chig brgyud du bka' rgyas gdams pa// snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba 'di rje btsun mas slob dpon tai lo pa la dngos su gdams/ tai lo pa la slob ma/ ka so ri pa/ ri ri pa/ grub thob brgyad rnams kyis o rgyan du mkha' 'gro ma la dngos su zhus pa'i chos de zhu byas pas// dran pa brjed med nā ro pas// bcu gnyis par du nga brten byas// nga yi de nyid kho la yod// phyi rabs rten gyi gang zag rnams// rtogs par 'dod na nā ro brten// gsung nas khong rnams la ma byin par/ nā ro pa gcig (481)pu la sbyin nas// bod kyi mar pa lung bstan te// phul+la ha ri'i dgon pa ru// ma ti ma rig mun pa sol// snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu yis// ye shes snang bas khyab par gyis/ ces gsungs/ nā ro paṇa chen nam dpal 'jigs med grags pa la slob ma ā ka ra saṃ dhi/ paṇ+ḍi ta shes rab ye shes/ ti phu la sogs mang du yod kyang ma gnang bar/ mar pa gcig pu la byin nas/ mi la ras pa bdag lung bstan pa// shar phyogs te los byin gyis brlabs// lho phyogs klu sgrub byin gyis brlabs// nub phyogs in dras byin gyis brlabs// byang phyogs nā ros byin gyis brlabs// kha ba can ljongs byang phyogs na// thos pa dga' zhes bya ba yi// gdul bya snod ldan yod pas song*// ces gsungs so// mar pa lo tsā la slob ma rngog chos rdor/

mar ba mgo yag mes chen po la sogs mang du yod kyang*/ mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud la yi ge med/ spel ba med gsung nas/ gzhan rnams la ma byin par kho bo gcig pu la gnang ba'o// de snga yan chad khrid kyi ngo bo la yi ge med par snyan brgyud zang ma yin pa la/ grod phug tu bcom ldan (482)'das ma'i zhal nas// mkha' 'gro gsang tshig nor bu de// rnal 'byor tsit+ta'i dkyil nas phyungs// badz+ra kī rti'i spyi bor zhog /'od zer dga' bas 'thung bar 'gyur// ces lung bstan pa'i phyir dang*// rdo rje grags pas yang dang yang du gsol ba btab pa'i phyir dang*/ las 'phro can gyi snod ldan rim par brgyud pa dang*/ khams gsum sems can ma lus pa drang ba'i don du/ mkha' 'gro'i bka' rgya bkrol nas bshad par bya'o// de'ang ye shes mkha' 'gro'i zhal nas snyan du brgyud pa 'di la gsum ste/ ston byed slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid dang*/ bstan pa slob ma'i mtshan nyid dang*/ bstan bya chos kyi gnas lugs so// dang po la drug ste lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa sdom pa gsum dang ldan pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa sems la rang dbang thob pa/ shes rab kyi bslab pa sngags kyi 'jug sgo rtogs pa/ byin rlabs 'byung ba'i gzhi brgyud pa dang ldan pa/ brgyud pa de ldan gyi gdams ngag nyams su myong ba/ thos bsam sde snod kyi 'jug tshul shes pas snyan brgyud kyi sgro 'dogs chod pa'o// slob ma la lnga ste/ dkar po'i gzhi zad pa mo gsham gyi bu lta bu ma yin pa ni/ dad pa med na yon tan gyi gzhi med pas/ dad pa la gsum/ dang ba'i dad pa yul khyad par can la drangs shing dad pa/ 'dod pa'i dad pa 'khor ba spong zhing mya ngan las 'das pa sgrub pa ste 'gro ba'i don bya bar 'dod pa/ yid ches pa'i dad pa mi dge bas ngan song*/ dge bas mtho ris/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags nyams su blangs nas sangs rgyas par shes pa'o// gnyis pa yon tan gyi rten du ma gyur pa rus sbal gyi spu lta bu ma yin pa ni/

dam tshig dang sdom pa med na yon tan skye ba'i rten med pas dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung nus pa'o// gsum pa chos brgyad kyi dbang du song ba bran lta bu ma (483)yin pa ni/ bde ba/ sdug bsngal ba/ bstod/ smad/ grags/ ma grags/ rnyed/ ma rnyed sogs mang po'i dbang du song na 'khor ba las mi thar bas/ des na chos brgyad kyi dbang du ma song bar brtson 'grus dang ldan pa'o// bzhi pa theg pa chen po'i snod dang mi ldan pa rigs chad pa lta bu ma yin pa ni/ snying rje chen po dang*/ thos byung dang*/ bsam byung dang*/ sgom byung gi shes rab dang ldan pa'o// lnga pa smin grol gyi snod dang mi ldan pa sin+dha pa ma yin pa ni/ sngags kyi spyod pa blor mi shong bar skur pa btab na dmyal bar skye bas// sngags kyi lta spyod la yon tan du mthong ba'o// bstan bya chos kyi gnas lugs la gsum ste/ phyi'i sgro 'dogs gcod pa sprul pa sku'i gdams pa brgyud pa yid bzhin nor bu/ nang nyams myong longs spyod rdzogs sku'i gdams pa smin lam yid bzhin nor bu/ gsang ba ngo sprod chos sku'i gdams pa grol lam yid bzhin nor bu'o// 'di la gsum ste/ bum dbang dang 'brel bar bsgom bya gtso bor bton pa thun mong yid bzhin nor bu/ spyi dang 'brel bar bsrung bya gtso bor bton pa dam tshig yid bzhin nor bu/ mchog dbang gsum dang 'brel bar de kho na nyid gtso bor ston pa gnas lugs yid bzhin nor bu'o// gnas lugs yid bzhin nor bu la drug ste/ gsang dbang dang 'brel par rdzogs rim rtsa rlung gi gnas de gtso bor bton pa steng sgo rnam par grol ba'i chos drug shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dang 'brel pa mkha' 'gro'i gsang ba sgrogs pa 'og sgo bde ba chen po/ tshig dbang dang 'brel par sku gsum sems la ngo sprod pa phyag rgya chen po ye shes gsal byed/ lam blo nas gcod pa ngo sprod bar do'i gdams pa dang*/

gdams ngag spyi'i gegs sel ba dang*/ lam cig car ba bya spyod tshogs su bsgyur ba lam gyi (484)gdams ngag go /dang po bum dbang dang 'brel ba bsgoms bya gtso bor bton pa thun mong yid bzhin nor bu la'ang gsum ste/ rgyal po chos nyid mi 'gyur ba/ blon po rigs gsum las byed pa phrin las mthun sbyor ro// dang po la thog mar las rgyu 'bras/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsam pa/ tshogs rdzogs pa'i yan lag tu stobs kyis gang 'byor ba'i gser gyi maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ bar chad sel zhing byin rlabs 'byung ba'i don du tshogs 'khor nges pa can bcu gnyis bskor/ zla ba drug tu khrid du bskyang bar bya'o/ mchan/ gsum/ yab rgyal po lta bu'i sgrub thabs/ yum rgyal mo lta bu'i sgrub thabs/ sras rgyal phran lta bu'i sgrub thabs so// de las 'dir yum gyi sgrub thabs gtso bor bton te/ lha mo gcig tu sgrub pa la rnal 'byor bcu las/ dang po tshad med pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ gnas yid dang mthun par mthun rkyen bsgrub// rten bkram/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ skyabs su 'gro zhing tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ gnyis pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgom pa ni/ spyi bor pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma sku gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan// sku mdog mthing ga spyan phyogs bcur gzigs pa/ g.yas ḍā ma ru/ g.yon dril bu dkur bsten pa/ sku gzi mdangs dang ldan pa 'dzum zhing gar mdzad pa/ de la brgyud pa'i bla ma/ chos 'brel zhus tshad/ yi dam/ sangs rgyas/chos/ dge 'dun thams cad 'od dang 'od zer gyi tshul du bstim/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor bar sgom/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ rtogs pa mchog tu gyur pa rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ ces gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab/ de rjes bla ma 'od du zhu rang la thim/ phyag rgya chen po'i dbang bzhug go /gsum pa lha sgom pa ni/

rang gi snying gi rtse mo gyen du bstan pa pad+ma dmar po 'dab (485)ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba/ de'i steng du bam̐/ de las 'od 'phros/ lus phyi nang sbyangs/ yang 'od 'phros/ snod bcud 'od du zhu/ 'od zer slar 'dus pa las/ bdag nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas 'jigs byed sngon po'i rna ba mnan pa/ g.yon bskum pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma nas mnan pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug mi mgo'i do shal/ thod skam lngas dbu brgyan pa/ spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa/ skra grol ba/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'bring po bsnams pa/ ma dang du khrod kyi dbus na snang la rang bzhin med pa/ 'du ba dang gshegs pa med pa/ ye shes kyi lus su yengs med du sgom/ mi gsal na bskyar zhing sgom/ bzhi pa 'jig rten gyi khams sbyangs pa ni/ snying ga'i bam̐ las 'od 'phros/ phyi snod la phog pas gzhal yas khang*/ nang bcud la phog pas skye 'gro pho thams cad bde mchog /mo thams cad rje btsun mar gyur par bsam/ lnga pa dpa' bo dpa' mo bsdu ba ni/ snying ga'i bam̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud kyi dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams la phog ste thams cad rang la thim par blta'o// drug pa rlung rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/ sna yi rtse mor thig le dkar dmar sran ma tsam rlung phar 'gro dus dkar po phar 'gro/ tshur 'jug dus dmar po tshur 'ong*/ res mos la sems gtad pas ye shes skye'o/ bdun pa ngag rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/ thugs ka'i bam̐ la sngags 'khor ba la sems gtad la/ nye snying ji srid du bzla'o// brgyad pa rdzogs rim ni/ snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros/ snod bcud 'od du zhu rang la thim/ rang yas 'dus mas 'dus/ zla ba la/ zla ba bam̐ la/ bam̐ zla tshes la/ zla tshes thig le la/ de nā da la/ nā da ring thung nas tsam/ phra sbom rta rnga brgyad gshags pa'i cha tsam/

mun khungs la glog 'khyugs pa tsam dmar khyem tsam la sems gtad/ de 'od du yal tser song ste dmigs pa ye dra med/ blos 'dzin med/ (486)shes pa bya bral du bzhag /bying na stod seng mgo dgye/ rig pa hur phyungs la phaṭa drag po gang ba/ rgod nam go phur/ sems 'phro na dbang dus dran par bya'o/ dgu pa bsre ba ro snyoms ni/ bsre ba dang ro snyoms gnyis po re re la'ang bzhi bzhi ste brgyad/ dang po smin pa dbang dang bsre ba/ grol ba lam dang bsre ba/ bsrung bya dam tshig dang bsre ba/ thob bya 'bras bu dang bsre ba'o// smin pa dbang dang bsre ba ni// bdag gi bskyed rdzogs bsgoms kyang*// smin pa dbang gi don ma bsgoms// grol ba lam yang ma bsgoms// bsrung bya dam tshig kyang ma bsrungs/ thob bya 'bras bu sku bzhi yang mi thob las che snyams na/ rang rje btsun ma'i spyi bor bla ma dang bcas pa gsal seng nge ba de bum dbang gi don yin/ bum dbang la'ang rnam pa gsal ba las gzhan bsgom rgyu med/ gsal ba do tsa na gsal ba rang gi sems su 'dug /sku mdog phyag mtshan rang rang gi ngo bos stong par 'dug pa gsang dbang gi don yin/ gsang dbang la ngo bo stong pa las gzhan bsgom rgyu med/ rnam pa gsal ba ngo bo stong pa gnyis dbyer med du nyams su myong ba bde ba zag pa med pa ste shes rab ye shes kyi don yin/ dbang gsum pa la'ang nyams myong bde ba las gzhan bsgom rgyu med/ de ltar rnam pa gsal ba dang*/ ngo bo stong pa dang*/ nyams myong bde ba dang*/ skye 'gags gnas gsum dang bral ba de tshig dbang gi don yin la/ dbang bzhi pa la'ang 'od gsal 'gro 'ong skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba las gzhan sgom rgyu med/ de ltar bskyed rim bsgoms pas dbang bzhi rdzogs pa'i nyams len gcig 'byung ste/ bum dbang dma' ste mar ma shor// tshig dbang mtho ste yar ma shor// gsang dbang dang shes rab ye shes par tshigs su ma lus par bskyed rim sgom bdo tsan/

dbang bskur thob ba do bas (487)gcig shes kun la mkhas pa'i man ngag yin ces bde mchog gi yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma des so// gnyis pa grol lam dang bsre ba la bzhi ste/ bskyed rim grol ba'i lam// rdzogs rim grol ba'i lam/ zung 'jug grol ba'i lam/ phyag rgya chen po grol ba'i lam mo// rang rje btsun mar gsal seng nge ba de bskyed rim gyi lam yin/ bskyed rim la'ang rnam pa gsal ba las gzhan bsgom rgyu med/ gsal dus na gsal ba ngo bos stong pa de rdzogs rim gyi lam yin/ rdzogs rim la'ang ngo bos stong pa las gzhan bsgom rgyu med/ nyams myong bde ba de zung 'jug gi lam yin/ zung 'jug la'ang nyams myong bde ba las gzhan bsgom rgyu med/ gsal stong bde ba dbyer med 'gro 'ong gnas gsum dang bral ba de phyag rgya chen po'i lam yin/ phyag rgya chen po la'ang 'od gsal 'gro 'ong gnas gsum dang bral ba las gzhan bsgom rgyu med/ des na bskyed rim byas pas zung 'jug gi lam rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor gcig 'byung ngo*// jo bo la la phyag rgya chen po go bas bskyed rim la blo mi 'jug zer/ la la stong nyid sgom pa'i dus min zer/ 'dir bskyed rim lam dma' ste mar ma shor/ phyag rgya chen po mtho ste yar ma shor/ rdzogs rim dang zung 'jug bar tshigs su ma lus par bskyed rim bsgom bdo tsan lam bzhi bgrod bdo bas/ gcig shes kun la mkhas pa'i man ngag dam pa'o// gsum pa dam tshig dang bsre ba la bzhi ste/ bum dbang gi dam tshig bskyed rim/ gsang dbang gi dam tshig rdzogs rim/ shes rab ye shes kyi dam tshig bde chen/ dbang bzhi pa'i dam tshig phyag rgya chen po'o// de ngo sprod na/ bdag nyid lhar gsal ba de bum dbang gi bsrung bya/ bum dbang gi dam tshig la'ang rnam pa gsal ba las gzhan bsgom rgyu med/ de bzhin du gong (488)bzhin 'gro'o/ bzhi pa thob bya 'bras bu dang bsre ba la bzhi ste/

gzugs sku/ chos sku/ bde ba chen po'i sku/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku'o// de ngo sprod na rnam pa gsal ba la 'phel 'grib med par brtan pa zob pa de gzugs sku/ ngo bo stong la 'phel 'gril med par brtan pa thob pa de chos sku/ nyams myong bde ba la brtan pa thob pa de bde ba chen po'i sku/ 'od gsal 'gro 'ong med pa la brtan pa thob pa de ngo bo nyid kyi sku'o// ngo bo nyid kyi sku la'ang 'od gsal 'gro 'ong med pa las gzhan bsgom rgyu med/ bskyed rim bsgoms pas sku bzhi thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa gcig byung ste/ ngo bo nyid sku mtho ste yar mi gtong pa la sogs gong gis 'gre'o// 'di ni 'bras bu lam du byed pa gcig shes kun la mkhas pa'i man ngag yin ces sangs rgyas kyi yum des gsungs so// bsre ba go bas ro snyoms go bar 'gyur ro// de yan chad la khrid dus rnal 'byor re re la dmigs skor re re bya'o// myong ba ma skyes bar du bsgom par bya'o// bcu pa gtor ma ni/ nges bcas tshes bcur/ nges med rgyun du'o// sha chang zan chu dang bcas pa gtor snod gtsang mar bshams te/ yoṃ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ kam̐ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum ka phyir bstan pa/ a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i dbus su/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dkar dmar mthing gsum/ lan gsum gyis rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ rdzas khol ba'i rlangs pas/ oṃ zhu nyes skyon dag āḥzhu zag med kyi bdud rtsir gyur/ hūm̐ zhu dpag tu med pa 'phel bar bsam/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas pheṃ pheṃ brjod pas snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad mdun du byon/ rtsa sngags la ba liṃ btags pa lan bdun gyis 'bul ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gsol bas mnyes par (489)bsam/ yi ge brgya pas bshags pa bya/ 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ badz+ra muḥs gshegs par bya/

rgyas par gzhan du shes so// rgyal po chos nyid mi 'gyur ba'o// blon po rigs gsum las byed la gsum/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ bdag 'jug ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur ba dang*/ yi ge brgya pa'i bzlas pa'o// dang po bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang lhar gsal ba'i spyi bor pam̐ las pad+ma'i sdong po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa/ kha dog sna tshogs rim pa bdun dang ldan par bsam/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa lta bu 'phros/ bla ma yi dam dbyer med spyan drangs pad+ma'i dbus su bzhugs/ bla ma dang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ brgyud pa'i bla ma dang chos 'brel yod tshad spyan drangs/ pad+ma'i phyi rim la bzhugs/ de bzhin du yi dam rnams de'i phyi rim du spyan drangs/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams de yi phyi rim la/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams de'i phyi rim la= dkon mchog gsum dang sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams de'i phyi rim la= grub thob brgyad cu sogs rnal 'byor pho mo rnams spyan drangs/ de yi phyi rim la bzhugs/ de thams cad 'od kyi lus can/ nang ma bas phyi ma cung zad dma' ba/ zhal rtsa ba'i bla ma la bstan par bsam/ de dag la phyag bya/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa dang lus 'bul/ bla ma la sangs rgyas su bltas la mos gus chen pos rtse gcig tu gsol ba btab/ de rnams rim gyis rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ bla ma spyi bor thim pas/ snying gar mi bskyod pa'i rnam pa 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro bar bzhugs pas ma rig pa sangs dag de 'od du yal/ rjes gnas lugs kyi ngang la bzhag /'di zab lam bla ma'i mos gus yin pas nyin mtshan du 'bad par bya'o// de ltar bsgoms pas bla ma'i (490)snang ba 'ba' zhig 'char rmi lam du chos zhu ba/ dbang bskur ba/ ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba sbyin pa la sogs pa 'byung ba byin rlabs kyis chos sku thob pa'i rtags so// gnyis pa bdag 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang ni/

skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang ldan pas/ rang gi mdun du rin po che'i khri/ phyogs bzhir rgyal chen bzhi/ khri mig na glang chen brgyad/ mtshams bzhi nas seng ge bzhis btegs pa'i nyi zla pad+ma'am/ dar 'bol brtsegs pa'i steng na rtsa ba'i bla ma yab yum 'khor los sgyur ba'i/ ngo bo bla ma la rnam pa bde mchog yab yum dgyes pa'i zhal ras 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ bdag la thugs kyi dgongs pas spyan gyis gzigs par bsam/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*/ yi dam lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro grangs med pa bla ma la bstim/ snyan brgyud pa la tha mal du sdod pa'i skabs gnyis te/ blon po rigs gsum las byed kyi bar mar ma gtogs lha ru gsal ba zhig dgos/ 'dir rang tha mal du 'dug pas phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa/ lus longs spyod dang rang gi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad ltos med du 'bul/ mos gus kyi gdung shugs bskyed la gsol ba thun mong ma yin pa yun ring du 'debs/ bla ma rin po ches bdag la bum pa'i dbang bskur du gsol ces pas/ bla ma yab yum kyi smin mtshams nas 'od zer kar po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin dkar na ra ra byung*/ rang gi smin mtshams su zhugs/ lus kyi dri ma dang sku'i dam tshig nyams chags sangs dag /lus shel ltar dag pa ste/ yi dam gyi skur gyur/ sku'i byin rlabs ma lus pa bdag gi lus la zhugs/ rig pa'i dbang lnga mtha' brten dang bcas pa thob par bsam/ bla ma rin po ches bdag la (491)gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol ces pas/ sbyor mtshams nas byang sems dkar dmar 'od dmar po dang bcas pa dmar na ra ra byung*/ rang gi lce thog tu babs/ ngag gi sgrib pa dang gsung gi nyams chag dag yi dam kyi sku snang la rang bzhin med par gyur/ gsung gi byin rlabs ma lus pa ngag la zhugs/ gsang ba'i dbang thob par bsam mo// bla ma rin po ches bdag la shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/

yab yum gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer sngon po byung*/ snying gar zhugs/ yid kyi sgrib pa dang thugs kyi nyams chag dag /rang yi dam du gsal ba de bde stong gi ngang nas bde phril phril bar gyur/ thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa yid la zhugs/ dbang gsum pa thob par bsam/ de rjes gsol ba btab pas/ gnas gsum gyi 'od zer sgo gsum du zhugs/ yab yum 'od du zhu/ rang la thims pa thugs sems gnyis med kyi ye shes kyi ngang la klod nas ji srid gnas pa de srid du bzhag /dbang bzhi pa thob/ rjes bsngo bas rgyas 'deb/ bsre ba ro snyoms sbyar/ khrid dus dmigs skor ni/ dus rgyun du zhag re la lan re mi blang kha med do// de ltar byas pas dam tshig nyes ltung thams cad sbyong*/ dge sbyor gyi bogs thon/ rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la skye/ bar do'i chags sdang rang grol du grol ba'o// ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur ba'o// gsum pa yi ge brgya pa'i bzlas pa ni/ sgrib gnyis ma sbyongs na tshogs gnyis mi rdzogs/ snam bu dri ma can la tshos bzang yang mi 'gos pa bzhin nyams sgrib can la gdams pa zab kyang rtogs pa mi skye bas/ de'i phyir na mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa sdig pa dag pa'i rtags ma byung gi bar ram/ grangs bsnyen 'bum tsho gsum/ dus bsnyen zla ba gcig gnas dben par smra bcad bya/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu dgu pa'o// (492)gtor ma bcas dbyar ma rul/ dgun ma 'khyags pa bya/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang ldan pas/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las spyi bor pam̐ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i steng du rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud la/ rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs phyed krung du bzhugs pa/

gnyis ka'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ dang bam̐ las yi ge brgya pa mu tig gi rdog po lta bu dkar ram me bas bskor bar bsam/ de yang ngo bo bla ma/ rnam pa rdo rje sems dpar bltas pa'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐

bsam/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi byung*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i hūm̐ dang yi ge brgya pa la thim/ sku'i nang thams cad gang*// zhabs g.yas pa'i sen dbrag nas cha'i them bu btang ba bzhin/ skya na ra ra tshangs bug nas zhugs lus kyi phyi nang thams cad bkrus/ nad gdon sdig sgrib nyams chags thams cad dud pa'am dri ma lta bu ba spu'i bu ga dang*/ gshang gci'i lam nas thon par bsam/ yi ge brgya pa bzla/ yang na bde mchog lhan skyes sku mdog dkar por bsam la/ he ru ka'i yig brgya bzla/ 'phro gcod dus mchod pa sna lnga dang gtor ma 'bul/ rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka'i zhal nas rigs kyi bu khyod kyi sgrib pa dag go gsungs nas 'od du zhu nas spyi bor thim/ thugs sems gnyis med kyi ngang du bsngo ba bya/ bsre ba ro snyoms sbyar/ dus rgyun du thun gyi stod smad la bya/ khrid dus dmigs skor gcig dang chos thun re la nyi shu rtsa re bya/ de ltar byas pas sgrib pa dag /dam tshig sor chud pa'i rtags rab zhal mthong*/ 'bring ting nge 'dzin skye/ mngon shes 'char (493)ba/ bla mas chos gsungs pa// dbang bskur ba la sogs 'byung*// tha ma rmi lam khyad par can// 'ja' tshon skas la 'dzeg pa dang*// nyi zla shar dang ri mthor 'dzeg /mi nag khyi nag bsad pa dang*// rnag khrag 'dzag dang ngan skyugs 'thon// gos dkar gon dang gru gzings gtor// dge sbyor la yang ngang gis 'jug /'jig rten chos la blo ldog pa// zhes sogs rtags rnams 'byung ngo*// yi ge brgya pa'i rnal 'byor*/ dmangs phal pa phrin las mthun sbyor la bdun/ bza' ba zas kyi rnal 'byor/ bgo ba gos kyi rnal 'byor/ nyal ba gnyid kyi rnal 'byor/ 'gro 'dug bskor ba'i rnal 'byor/ bkru ba khrus kyi rnal 'byor/ gsol 'debs maṇ+ḍal gyi rnal 'byor/ tshogs gsog chos spyod kyi rnal 'byor ro// dang po bza' ba zas kyi rnal 'byor la gsum ste/

tha mas sems gsum sngon du song nas lhar gsal btab/ spyi bor bka' brgyud bla ma/ snying gar 'khor lo sdom pa/ yan lag tshigs la mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma ba spu'i bu gar rdo rje'i spun rnams dmigs te/ bza' btung gang yang rung ba rnams/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir bsgom la lag pa g.yon pas longs spyod/ de thams cad mnyes par bsam/ lhag ma la bdud rtsir rang la bstim la gzhan la sbyin no// 'bring gis lha ru bden 'dzin dang bral ba sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang du za/ rab chos nyid ngang nas ma bcos pa'i klong du rol lo// dper na zas gter dang 'dra ste/ zhim mi zhim gyi rtogs pa med pa'o// snyan brgyud kyi sgor zhugs nas zas kyi rnal 'byor ma chags par bya'o// de ltar rgyun du byas pas bza' btung thams cad tshogs 'khor du song*/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mnyes/ bar chad zhi/ mthun (494)rkyen phun sum tshogs pa 'grub/ byin rlabs myur ba'o// / bgo ba gos kyi rnal 'byor ni/ sems bskyed dang ldan pas/ gos rgyan ske rags zhwa l+h+wam la sogs pa gon tshad kyi dus su rang lhar gsal gdab/ na bza' dang rgyan phreng du gsal gdab la 'bul/ ngag tu oṃ spar+she āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod/ gsar pa yin na rtsa sngags lan gsum bzlas nas btab pas byin rlabs 'byung*/ dang po nas lha la dmigs pas tshogs rdzogs/ gon dus lag pa g.yon pas sngon la gyon/ de ltar dus rgyun du bya/ gos gyon tshad byang chub kyi lam du 'gro'o// dar zab la sogs pa 'dod yon la longs spyod pa dang*/ ngo tsha dang khrel yod tshul khrims kyi gos dang ldan par 'gyur ro// nyal ba gnyid kyi rnal 'byor la gsum ste/ sems bskyed byas/ rab 'od gsal/ 'bring sgyu lus/ tha ma lha skur nyal ba'o// dang po 'od gsal du nyal ba la spros bcas spros med gnyis las/ spros bcas ni/ snod bcud dkyil 'khor du gsal gdab/ snod bcud la thim/

bcud kyi lha rnams rang la/ rang thugs ka'i bam̐ la/ bam̐ zla tshes la/ de nā da la/ de 'od du zhu/ rjes mi rtog pa'i ngang la nyal lo// spros med skad cig gis stong pa'i ngang du nyal lo// 'bring sgyu lus su nyal ba la/ spros bcas spros med gnyis las spros bcas ni/ snang ba thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma yin snyams pa'i ngang nas g.yas 'og tu phab la nyal/ spros med ni/ sgyu ma mi bden bzhin snang ba yin snyam du bsam la nyal/ tha ma lha skur nyal ba la/ spros bcas spros med gnyis las/ spros bcas ni/ rje btsun ma'i bskyed rim sgom pa'i ngang du nyal/ spros med ni/ skad cig gis lhar bltas te snang la rang bzhin med pa'i ngang du nyal/ gnyid sad pa'i dus su ḍā ma ru'i sgras gnyid sad par bsam mo// (495)dang po 'od gsal lam gang rung la bzhag pa de'i ngang la bzhag /bsre ba ro snyoms rnal 'byor bdun char la sbyar bar bya'o// 'di dus rgyun du ma chag par bya/ khrid dus dmigs skor gcig /de ltar nyams su blangs pas mtshan mo gnyid pas kyang 'chi ba skyong*/ rmi lam gyis bar do sbyong*/ snga dro sad pas skye ba sbyong*/ gnyid kyis gti mug 'gags// rmi lam gyis 'dod chags 'gags// sad pas zhe sngags 'gas/ nyal tshad byang chub kyi lam du 'gro'o// 'gro 'dug bskor ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ sems bskyed bya/ ring ba lo zla nas/ thung ba chu len pa'i 'gro lam tshun thams cad du rkang pa g.yon pa sngon la dor te shes rab mtshan/ g.yas pa thabs/ lam zung 'jug mtshon nas// 'gro ba de o rgyan nam/ bla ma yi dam gyi drung du 'gro bar bsam ste/ tshur ldog dus kyang de bzhin no// 'di rgyun du 'gro 'ong byad tshad lam brjed par bya'o// de ltar byas pas 'khrul pa 'gro 'ong gi rnam rtog tha mal pa 'gags/ mtshan bltas bla ma'i spyan sngar phyin pa dang*/ zhal mthong ba la sogs 'byung*/ 'gro 'dug thams cad byang chub kyi lam du 'gro'o// bkru ba khrus kyi rnal 'byor ni/

sems bskyed bya/ rigs lnga yab yum sku mdog ser po gsal ba rus pa'i rgyan can/ g.yas rdo rje la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan so so// g.yon dril bu bsnams pa spyi bor byon/ mchod pa phul/ gsol ba btab pas yum rnams kyi phyag gi thod pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun lud pas sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag par bsams la yi ge brgya pa brjod cing khrus bya/ de nas rigs lnga mi bskyod pa la thim/ de rang la thim/ de nas g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas/ oṃ bam̐ swā hā zhes chu sbyin byas nas/ rigs drug gi sgrib pa dag nas sdug bsngal dang (496)bral/ bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig ces brjod/ don yid la bsam/ chu khyor par cung zad blug ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod nas rang gis 'thung bas zhag gcig gi bsrung bar 'gyur/ de 'grub na nyin re bzhin dngos su bya/ ma grub na ting nge 'dzin bya'o// de ltar byas pas sdig sgrib nyams chags dag /mi gtsang ba mkhon grib la sogs pa sel/ nad gdon gyi bar chad mi 'byung*/ rig pa dwangs/ ting nge 'dzin gsal lo// khrus byas tshad byang chub kyi lam du 'gro'o// gsol 'debs maṇ+ḍal gyi rnal 'byor la gnyis te/ sgrub pa'i dang*/ mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal lo// dang po ni rgyu rin po che las byas pa/ 'byor na khru skor/ ma 'byor na sor bzhi yan chad kha khyer mtho ba/ yid du 'ong ba/ gas chag dang rdol bug med pa tshags byas la/ legs par phyis te/ dkyil du srin lag g.yon pa bzhag la/ ngag tu oṃ badz+ra bigh+nā na ta kṛ ta āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas bgegs bsal/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūm̐/ brjod pas zhing khams rnams par dag pa rin po che las grub pa yangs shing rgya che bar bsam/ de'i dkyil du me tog gi tshom bu lag pa g.yas kyis bzhag pas/ seng ge'i khri nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng na hūm̐ bam̐ las ngo bo bla ma/ rnam pa bde mchog yab yum du bsam mdun nas me tog phyogs g.yas bskor du/

mām̐ lām̐ pām̐ tām̐/ bzhi bkod/ lha mo bzhi ru bsam/ de la mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal la sogs pa 'bul/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bdag la rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol ces gsol ba btab/ lha mo rnams bla ma la thim/ bla ma rang la thim/ rjes phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la bzhag /bsre ba ro snyoms sbyar/ me tog thad kar ma song nyan thos kyi pham ltung phog pas thu pa ma gud par bya/ gnyis pa mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal ni/ rgyu rin po che las byas pa ni gong dang 'dra/ gnyis (497)med na gong gi lha tshogs bar snang la btegs par dmigs te/ maṇ+ḍal phyis la/ 'byung po me long gdong can gyi bar chad bsrung ste/ g.yon gyi srin lag gis lan gsum bskor la/ oṃ āḥbigh+nā na a nu ghā ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bgegs bskrad/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ ces pas gser gyi sa gzhi lag mthil ltar mnyam par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra su re khe āḥhūm̐ ces pas rin po che'i lcags ris bskor bar bsam/ de nas lag pa g.yas kyis tshom bu g.yon bskor du bkod la/ bcu gcig gam/ bcu dgu'am/ sum cu so bdun la sogs pa bkod/ ngag tu brjod cing don bsam pa ni/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho dzam+bu gling*/ nub ba glang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ gling bzhi/ gling phran brgyad/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ 'khor lo rin po che/ nor bu rin po che/ btsun mo rin po che/ blon po rin po che/ glang po rin po che/ rta mchog rin po che/ dmag dpon rin po che/ bkra shis kyi gdugs dang*/ gser gyi nya dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ bum pa dang*/ dung dang*/ dpal be'u dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ gser gyi ri bdun/ rol pa'i mtsho bdun/ me tog gi skyed mo'i tshal/ lha mi'i dpal 'byor bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba dang bcas pa thams cad ltos med du phul la/ bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dge tshogs bcas// bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas rnams la 'bul// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes nas kyang*// bdag gzhan smin cing grol bar mdzad du gsol/

ces brjod/ khrid du dmigs skor gnyis bya/ chos thun re re la lan re 'bul/ sgrub pa'i dus su grangs med/ rgyun du nyi ma re la lan gsum ma chags par bya'o// dngos su ma 'byor na ting nge 'dzin gyis 'bul/ de ltar byas pas rtags rmi lam du rin po che'i thang la phyin pa dang*/ rin po che (498)dang 'bru'i char babs pa dang*/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gros thod pa rdzas kyis bkang ba ster ba la sogs 'byung ngo*// dngos su 'khor dang dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa lo zlas 'grub/ gnas skabs su mtho ris kyi bde 'bras thob ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skye// sangs rgyas pa'i dus su zhing khams dang mdzad pa rnam par dag pa 'byung*/ bsre ba ro snyoms sbyar ro// tshogs gsog chos spyod kyi rnal 'byor ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun du dbus su rin po che sna bdun las grub pa'i khri bang rim bdun dang ldan pa yangs shing rgya che ba gcig bsam/ mdun du shel gyi khri/ g.yas su gser gyi khri/ rgyab tu bye ru'i khri dmar po/ g.yon du g.yu'i khri sngon po re re bsam/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ bla ma bka' brgyud rnams byon/ khri dbus mar bzhugs/ yang 'od 'phros yi dam lha tshogs spyan drangs mdun du bzhugs/ yang 'od 'phros dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang*/ 'jig rten na bzhugs pa'i sku'i rten lugs su blugs pa/ ri mor bris pa/ 'bur du 'dod pa thams cad g.yas su bzhugs/ chos dkon mchog glegs bam la sogs rgyab tu bzhugs/ yang 'od 'phros/ dge 'dun dkon mchog grangs med pa snam sbyar chos gos gsol ba spyan drangs g.yon du bzhugs/ de dag gi mthar dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang rdo rje'i spun rnams kyis bskor bar dmigs la spyan drangs pa ni// chos dbyings rnam dag gzhal yas nas// bla ma yi dam lha tshogs rnams// sngon gyi thugs dam brtser dgongs la// 'gro ba'i don du gnas 'dir gshegs// oṃ ma hā gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sam+bha ra badz+ra yo gi ni wī ra ḍā ki nī badz+ra ā ral+li hoḥdzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ tri sh+ya hoḥ

mdzes shing yid 'ong gzhal yas khang*// rin chen sna tshogs seng ge'i khri// chu skyes nyi zla'i gdan steng du// dges shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol// oṃ ma hā gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sam+bha ra badz+ra yo gī nī wi ra ḍā ki ni/ de la phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyis mchod nas/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ de la phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyis (499)mchod pas sa gzhi bar snang thams cad gang bas lus longs spyod dang*/ nyams dang rtogs pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad ltos med du rim pa bzhin du phul bar dmigs la/ yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba ni/ chos sku spros bral ngang nyid las// sna tshogs gzugs kyi skur ston pa'i// bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas la// sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// rab 'byams zhing khams thams cad na// me tog bdug spos mar me dri// zhal zas rol mo mchod pa'i tshogs// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// 'phan dang ba dan rgyal mtshan dang*// phye ma'i phur ma gdugs dang ni// bla bre dar dbyangs bkod pa'i tshogs// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// rin chen snod mdzes gzhal yas khang*// rin chen gyis bkang mchod pa'i tshogs// ma lus blo yis blangs nas kyang*// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// kun 'byung sdug bsngal skyed byed pa'i// shes rab mig bral bdag lus 'di// bran g.yog bzhin du dmigs nas kyang*// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga rnams ni// rigs lnga ye shes lnga yi dngos// dug lnga sel ba'i thabs mchog ni// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// yab yum thabs shes gnyis su med// bde stong gnyis med rol nga yi// zag med bde chen mchod pa'i tshogs// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// bde dang gsal dang mi rtog pa// snang stong zung 'jug phyag rgya che// rang bzhin rnam dag mchod pa 'di// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// sdig bgyis bgyid rtsal rjes yi rangs// phyin chad bgyid par 'gyur ba yi// chos 'gal nyes pa ci mchis pa// de ring nyid du bdag bshags so// so so skye bo nyan rang dang*// byang sems sangs rgyas sras bcas kyi// dus gsum nyid du bgyis pa yi// dge la rjes su yid rang ngo*// bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas rnams// sems can kun (500)gyi don gyi phyir// chos kyi 'khor lo 'od 'bar ba// mun pa bsal phyir bskor du gsol// dri med rgyal ba chos kyi ni// spyan can mang na chen po las// 'da' bar bzhed pa khyed rnams kyang*// 'gro ba'i don du rtag tu bzhugs// bdag gzhan kun gyi dus gsum du// bsags pa'i dge ba ji snyed des// bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog
